registry_lifecycle.consumer: msg.sender; checked on completion and cancellation
registry_lifecycle.idempotency: identical live prefix accepted without extending expiry
registry_lifecycle.replacement: fresh begin replaces expired same key; other proof-derived keys independent
registry_lifecycle.replay: completed checkpoint deleted; partB alone cannot replay; registry intentionally does not enforce application nullifier replay (local pool owns that)

measurement_contract: Isolated frozen/framed transcript runs use the same typed observation/sample schedule but different cryptographic states. Whole-path fresh frozen control and T3-02 proof runs include full512 and split overhead. Never sum isolated savings into integrated claims.

entrypoints.input_override: Native accepts --statement PATH --witness PATH --consumer 0xPUBLIC_ADDRESS --parameter-id 0x64BYTES; --proof PATH reuses a real postcard proof and labels proving measurement as reused
entrypoints.node_policy: No daemon startup. Only loopback Anvil31337 and public test account accepted. Foundry runs in /tmp allowlist source mirror without .env or dotenv ancestors. Subprocess environment is allowlisted.

q48_control.balance_rule: Choose measured successful split minimizing max(actual A receipt gas, actual B receipt gas); missing execution is not a projected winner
